newsitem.title: USA: Pilares takes 23 pct Power Save stake.
newsitem.headline: Pilares takes 23 pct Power Save stake.

text.p: Power Save International Inc said on Monday Pilares Oil & Gas Inc has taken a 23 percent equity stake in the company for $10 million in oil and gas reserve assets.
Power Save said in a statement that after dilution, completion of the deal would increase its shareholder equity by $1.19 per share.
Rayomd Bolduc had been named company president and chief executive officer, the company also said.
Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Scott Balmer had previously held the positions, the company said. Bolduc would lead the company to full scale operations, it said.
Power Save said also it expected the Pilares deal would provide about $1 million in annual pre-tax earnings, when the reserves became productive.
The company said it would use some of the money from a planned secondary offering to make the reserves productive.
Power Save said it also would pursue an aggressive acquisition program, with 20 planned in the next five years.
It said letters of intent for stock swaps had been executed with two entities. Power Save said the deals would provide it with a nominal $4 million in revenue and annual pre-tax earnings of $500,000.
Two more acquisitions were planned for the end of 1996, to boost Power Save's revenues to a nominal $10 million, with pre-tax earnings of $1 million.
Power Save leases, sells and services commercial cogeneration air heating systems.
